name: termux-x11
readme_excerpt: Termux:X11 A Termux X11 server add-on app. About Termux:X11 is a fully fledged X server. It is built with Android NDK and optimized to be used with Termux. Submodules caveat This repo uses submodules. Use or How does it work? Just like any other X server. Setup Instructions Termux:X11 requires Android 8 or later.
